visa-preparation.fastest_entry: No visa for tourists; Andorra is outside Schengen but only reached through France or Spain.
steps: Meet Schengen entry rules for France or Spain on the way in.
Leaving Andorra means re-entering Schengen; carry your passport.

laws.rule: Andorra has a zero-tolerance policy on the possession and use of illegal drugs. Punishment for possession of even the smallest amount of illegal drugs can include refusal of entry, expulsion from the country, fines and prison sentences.
laws.heading: Illegal drugs

laws.rule: Andorra is a generally tolerant place for LGBT+ travellers. Same-sex marriage is legal in Andorra. Transgender people can register under their preferred sex in public documents without undergoing prior gender reassignment surgery. Read advice for LGBT+ travellers .
